sourceRevisionQualification: Before-inventory metadata retains its original inspected revision; sourceRevision supplies the native translated commit when a completed rewrite map is provided.

before.locations: First25 unique locations per grouped row are public; complete original metadata remains retained privately.

after.qualification: Only explicitly reported scan metrics are copied; no private matching text is published.

scopeLimitations.initialUnguardedScan: Initial native working-directory and interrupted traversal attempts may have opened ignored build-cache metadata in process memory before read guards were introduced. No raw cache content was printed or copied into reports, and no live credential was confirmed.
scopeLimitations.completedGuardedRuns: Completed guarded source scans excluded23 protected cache/dependency locations before reads. Any credentialFilesOpened=0 field describes its guarded run only; no task-wide assertion that credential files were never opened is made.

embeddedDirectives.sourceScope: Locations captured by the completed post-initial-redaction working-tree inventory, before supplemental case-fold and generated-publication metadata updates; no fresh discovery scan of later generated files is claimed.
